question: What ordering does a map's text guarantee?
ruling: Map is equivalent to un-ordered map, i.e. there are no ordering guarantees provided.
rationale: A map has no order, so the order of members in its text is unspecified. Sets have no order either (VAL-8) and are treated the same way.
expected: each rendering is the text of the expected map, in any member order

question: Should a set operator's first admitted evaluation publish an empty dictionary?
ruling: Yes (owner: 'I suspect the answer should be yes. But make sure it makes sense to you as well.').
rationale: An admitted result is a value even when empty. The four operators follow one rule; otherwise a three-operand symmetric difference whose first two operands cancel would never publish.
expected: The first admitted evaluation publishes, empty or not
